test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Eight people F, H, K, N, P, S, V, X are sitting in a straight line and all are facing north.

Neither F nor H sit at any of the extreme ends of the line. F sits fourth to the right of H. Only two people sit between F and K. More than two people sit between P and K. P does not sit at an extreme end. S sits to the immediate right of V. X sits at one of the positions to the left of V.

What is the position of N from the right end of the line?
solution:
Eight people F, H, K, N, P, S, V, X are sitting in a straight line and all are facing north.

1) F sits fourth to the right of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f542d78e452470101dfe7264e4efcafcf1192a1f5cfae5b0af387d660f0e1203.png] 

2) Only two people sit between F and K.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4697942af1694157a724d1bbf1bd0905004af6680b5fb76bc3dfeb8a82f40b3a.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e747365dcb3fc24224a394d90a7fe208a48446bbbf9f38d2310f2afeafc8cadc.png] 

3) Neither F nor H sits at any of the extreme ends of the line. More than two people sit between P and K and P does not sit at an extreme end.

So, here case (ii) gets eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab82e43b9c1b2312913328014ad6a92e30c89c98195cd9918d657ec34d7e1033.png] 

4) S sits to the immediate right of V. X sits at one of the positions to the left of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11dcabb650378d88ed1d53f35f885079cfc62a012410d5fb5c337f8b213d610f.png] 

∴ Here, the position of 'N' is 'first' from right end of the line.

Hence, the correct answer is** "First".**
